acceptance_criteria.criteria: All business workflows and user operations execute with 100% success rate without uncaught exceptions.
Security, performance SLAs, and system resilience metrics satisfy non-functional requirements.
User interface provides responsive navigation, accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and zero dead links.
All inter-agent message buses, database connections, and external API connectors function cleanly.
Transactions maintain ACID properties with zero record corruption, drift, or state inconsistency.
Strict RBAC enforcement, encrypted data transmission, and compliance validation.
95th percentile response times below 200ms and sustained throughput above 100 RPS.
Evaluated user feedback rating exceeds 4.5 out of 5.0 points.
